summary: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings, with a hosted MCP server and an Enterprise REST API.
access_note: Public REST API is Enterprise-workspace only with static Bearer keys; the hosted MCP server works from a standard Otter account over OAuth.
blocker_note: REST API needs an Enterprise workspace; non-Enterprise users only reach data via the MCP server.

evidence.quote: the Public API is gated to Enterprise workspaces and authenticates with Bearer API keys only, no OAuth.
The Public API is a REST surface at api.otter.ai/v1

notes: help.otter.ai returned 403 and otter.ai/api/docs returned no body, so API facts rely on a third-party source (Scalekit). MCP URL https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp is from claude.com/connectors/otter-ai (fetched) and returns 401 unauthenticated.
